Posted 'Tatooine Jabbas Palace x3' kept at qty 3 as published (a unique site); 'Death Star Docking Bay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'TINT & OE' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Ghhhk & TRWEU' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Contol & Set For Stun' Control & Set For Stun.

The strategy starts SYCFA with Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327 and Alderaan, then Prepared Defenses for three Effects (usually No Bargain, Power Of The Hutt, Mobilization Points; TINT & OE or Secret Plans in some matchups). Alderaan and Secret Plans are not in the posted list and are not added. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
The description says the deck is 8-0 in local tournament play (no named event), so it is filed as general.
